clock: System clock (Node Date, UTC ISO-8601); does not use session-injected timestamps
maxAnchorsNote: Registration ceiling during initialization scan to prevent dependencies/artifacts from flooding registry; unrelated to runtime paths

anchorSchema.path: Relative path to projectRoot (prevents machine-locked absolute paths)
anchorSchema.sha256: SHA-256 hash of file content to detect archive drift
anchorSchema.l2: Suggested L2 subdomain id, must exist in config/taxonomy.json

mapping.primary: item.localDirectory = primary anchor (single, always the first item)
mapping.extraLimitNote: lib/schema.js:43 sanitizeLocalDirectories slices extra to 20; up to 21 total paths with primary. Hard system limit
mapping.softCheck: Paths serve as traceability hints; no strict check requiring identical file and task names

rules: Primary anchor must be the single file that best reproduces the task verdict (test script / spec / deliverable), not an arbitrary related file.
Related files should follow evidence chain order; update sha256 and append a [Correction] note when files change, never replace silently.
Paths should preferably be relative to projectRoot; absolute paths are strictly for local troubleshooting and should not enter version control.
Every task should register at least one primary anchor; if no file exists, note 'No file anchor; evidence is command output' in [File Anchors].
